name: dev-team
description: The shared core dev team: architect, owner, fixer, gate-runner, reviewer, spec-auditor, critic, security-reviewer, approver, scribe and repo-auditor, with fourteen skills they load and one milestone loop they all follow: five reviews in parallel, one combined findings list, at most two fix rounds, and an approver that merges only where the app opts in to auto-merge. Includes the design team's Design stage and design check for milestones that change screens. Each app keeps its own memory, specs, gate and specialists.
